self.mask_token = itemnum + 1
        self.register_buffer("input_log_count", torch.zeros(itemnum + 2))
        self.register_buffer("input_mean_log_count", torch.zeros(()))
        self.register_buffer("input_std_log_count", torch.ones(()))
        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 2, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)

visible_real = (seq > 0) & (seq <= self.itemnum)
        rarity = (self.input_mean_log_count - self.input_log_count[seq]) / self.input_std_log_count.clamp_min(1e-6)
        input_scale = torch.where(
            visible_real, 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.tanh(rarity), torch.ones_like(rarity)
        )
        input_scale = input_scale.masked_fill(seq == 0, 0.0)
        item_vectors = item_vectors * input_scale.unsqueeze(-1)
        x = item_vectors * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)

training_counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 2, dtype=np.float64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(training_counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1.0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        log_counts = torch.as_tensor(np.log1p(training_counts), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        real_log_counts = log_counts[1:itemnum + 1]
        model.input_log_count.copy_(log_counts)
        model.input_mean_log_count.copy_(real_log_counts.mean())
        model.input_std_log_count.copy_(real_log_counts.std(unbiased=False).clamp_min(1e-6))
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
